observation.visible_scene: A flameless electric candle stands centered on a dark turned candlestick holder atop a round table against a black background; a thin power cord trails off to the right. The candle's translucent cylindrical body is filled with a churning bubble stream lit from within, and a small orange LED 'flame' flickers at the top. The tabletop catches a colored pool of light from the candle.
visible_changes: The internal illumination hue shifts gradually over the excerpt from a cyan/teal glow (early frames) toward a brighter blue‑white glow (later frames), and the tint of the wax 'drip' crown changes accordingly from cyan to pale white/pink.

Bubbles inside the cylinder continuously churn and rise, their pattern changing every frame; intermittent colored glints (magenta/pink, occasionally green) flash within the bubble column, most noticeable from about the middle of the segment onward.
The orange flame tip flickers, altering its shape and slight tilt from frame to frame (leaning left or right, taller or shorter), without the candle body moving.
The reflected light pool on the tabletop changes color in step with the candle's internal hue, starting cyan and becoming more blue‑white with faint pink tints later.
The candle, holder, and cord remain fixed in the same positions throughout; the black background and table edge are unchanged, indicating no camera motion.
outside_clip_unknowns: The state of the light before t=0 and whether the hue continues cycling to other colors after the last frame are not shown.
The mechanism driving the bubble motion and the color cycle (motor, programmed LED sequence) cannot be determined from the images.
uncertain_details: Whether the hue change is a smooth continuous cycle or stepped color modes cannot be resolved at this frame rate.
The apparent motion of individual bubbles is hard to track precisely; only the overall churning pattern is clearly changing.
